inputs.plan: Implement the ExternalReviewAdapter interface in review/qodo.go for the QodoAdapter struct. The interface requires methods: TriggerReview(ctx, client, prNumber) error, ReviewReady(ctx, client, prNumber) (bool, error), and ParseFindings(ctx, client, prNumber) ([]ReviewFinding, error). TriggerReview posts a comment requesting review. ReviewReady checks if the tool has responded. ParseFindings extracts structured findings.
